findings.claim: KLA 10-K FY2026 列名競爭對手為 Applied Materials、ASML、Hitachi High-Tech、Lasertec、Onto Innovation，並表示未來可能面對海內外新進入者；未載明份額消長數字。
findings.excerpt: In each of our product markets, we have many competitors, including companies such as Applied Materials, Inc., ASML Holding N.V., Hitachi High-Tech Corporation, Lasertec, Inc. and Onto Innovation, Inc., some of which may have greater financial, research, engineering, manufacturing and marketing resources than we have.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：部分競爭對手可能捆綁產品並以顯著低於 KLA 的價格銷售競品設備，且面臨專攻局部市場的新興小公司競爭。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2026 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: These competitors may bundle their products in a manner that may discourage customers from purchasing our products, including pricing such competitive tools significantly below our product offerings. In addition, we face competition from smaller emerging companies whose strategy is to provide a portion of the products and services that we offer

findings.claim: 聚合文稱 KLA 製程控制份額自2021年擴大360bp、約為最近競爭者7倍；BofA 資料晶圓檢測份額81.9%（年增83bps）；Onto 為先進封裝檢測/量測最直接對手。
findings.source: Nasdaq/Zacks: Is KLA the Biggest Process Control Winner From AI Spending?

findings.claim: Onto Innovation 在先進封裝檢測、量測挑戰 KLA，Dragonfly 檢測業務 2026Q2 季增30%。
findings.source: Nasdaq: KLA Gains From Advanced Packaging: Can it Outpace ONTO & AMAT?

note: 搜尋結果僅為聚合站摘要（含 KLA 稱製程控制份額自 2021 年擴大 360bp、BofA 晶圓檢測份額 81.9%、Onto 在先進封裝檢測挑戰），未讀到頁面原文，列為 clues；未找到新進入者取代 KLA 的來源。 線索 2 條，程式核實 0 條，2 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
